attribution.text: Metadata provided by TheTVDB. Please consider adding missing information or subscribing.

provenance.notes: No rate limit is published: the terms forbid "excessive calls to the API, as determined by us". Licences by the project's yearly revenue: free with the credit under US$50,000, then paid tiers (US$1,000 a year to US$250,000, US$10,000 to US$1 million, a contract above); or a subscriber-supported key whose every user has a TheTVDB subscription (the pin option); discounts for open-source projects. Commercial use is therefore allowed under these licences (contract). The credit with a direct link to TheTVDB.com is shown to whoever sees the metadata. Keeping a copy of the database or a caching proxy is recommended (github.com/thetvdb/v4-api); reselling or distributing the data is not. The API licence does not cover images: their use needs their owners' permission.
